name: linak-desk-controller
title: Linak Desk Controller
description: Control the height of standing desks manufactured by Linak, for example the Ikea Idasen desk, over Bluetooth.
author: samuelkraft

preferences.name: sitHeight
preferences.description: The height in cm of your desk when sitting.
preferences.title: Sitting height

preferences.name: standHeight
preferences.description: The height in cm of your desk when standing.
preferences.title: Standing height

preferences.name: stepSize
preferences.description: How many cm Raise Desk and Lower Desk move the desk.
preferences.title: Raise/lower step

preferences.name: baseHeight
preferences.description: The height in cm of your desk at its lowest position. Change this if the reported height is off by a constant amount.
preferences.title: Lowest height

preferences.name: uuid
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty to find your desk automatically, or use the Select Desk command to pick one.
preferences.title: Desk identifier

commands.name: move-to-stand
commands.title: Stand Up
commands.subtitle: Linak Desk Controller
commands.description: Move your desk to your standing height

commands.name: move-to-sit
commands.title: Sit Down
commands.subtitle: Linak Desk Controller
commands.description: Move your desk to your sitting height

commands.name: move-to-custom
commands.title: Move Desk to Custom Height
commands.subtitle: Linak Desk Controller
commands.description: Move your desk to custom height

commands.name: step-up
commands.title: Raise Desk
commands.subtitle: Linak Desk Controller
commands.description: Raise your desk by a few centimeters

commands.name: step-down
commands.title: Lower Desk
commands.subtitle: Linak Desk Controller
commands.description: Lower your desk by a few centimeters

commands.name: stop-desk
commands.title: Stop Desk
commands.subtitle: Linak Desk Controller
commands.description: Stop your desk if it's moving

commands.name: select-desk
commands.title: Select Desk
commands.subtitle: Linak Desk Controller
commands.description: Find nearby desks and choose which one to control

tools.name: raise-desk
tools.title: Raise Desk to Standing Height
tools.description: Raise your standing desk to your standing height

tools.name: lower-desk
tools.title: Lower Desk to Sitting Height
tools.description: Lower your desk to your sitting height

tools.name: move-desk
tools.title: Move Desk to Custom Height
tools.description: Lower your desk to a specific custom height in cm
